scope: Remove lifecycle statuses from asset-category shortcuts, safely deactivate legacy pseudo-categories, and prevent lifecycle values from being recreated as active categories without changing the approved architecture or existing assets.

evidence: database/Migrations/008-separate-lifecycle-from-categories.sql deactivates legacy categories and dependent profiles rather than deleting business configuration
The migration stops without changing data when an asset uses a reserved lifecycle category
backend/src/lifecycle.ts defines the six governed lifecycle status keys once
backend/test/lifecycle.test.ts and backend/test/contract.test.ts verify that lifecycle statuses remain status values and cannot appear in the asset-family catalogue
database/Migrations/008-separate-lifecycle-from-categories.sql is uniquely journaled, transactional, forward-only, and guarded before mutation
backend/test/databaseContract.test.ts verifies the migration safety, constraint, journal key, and required schema contract
backend/src/admin.ts rejects lifecycle keys and names when creating asset categories and directs administrators to the Status dropdown
database/001-production-baseline.sql and migration 008 enforce the same boundary in PostgreSQL
backend/src/session.ts and backend/src/registry.ts return only asset-family categories to Search and Inventory
Available, Rework, and E-Waste remain lifecycle terminology in management KPIs and status workflows instead of duplicate category shortcuts
The correction is delivered as a component delta from 1.3.9 to 1.3.10
No baseline reinstall, database replacement, or page redesign is included
The permanent updater verifies fromVersion, file hashes, schema prerequisites, and complete target component manifests before publishing
Release tools 1.2.1 replace the unbounded Windows process scan with a bounded port 3020 owner check before migration
operations/Test-Delta-Package.ps1 validates the governed delta package
The delta manifest embeds this Framework v1.0 conformance record and migration ID
The permanent updater records version, package hash, operator, components, migration, health checks, and outcome in the release ledger
